newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat higher, May soy steady.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat higher, May soy steady.

text.p: Argentine cash wheat was quoted sharply higher and May soybeans held steady, resisting a slump in Chicago, on Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange Tuesday, dealers said.
Cash wheat was $3 to $4 firmer on market factors, as sellers failed to meet position-covering demand. Cash maize was unchanged on the previous day.
Spot soybean weakened $3 to $4 on expectations of new-crop arrivals, but May soybean was quoted firm to $1 higher because of continued concerns about crop quality from fungus.
Sunseed trade was thin with few price changes.
